'''Mollusks''' were a group of living creatures. The [[Croke]] may have been mollusks.<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] ate mollusks.<ref name="A Free Quarren in the Palace: Tessek's Tale">"[[A Free Quarren in the Palace: Tessek's Tale]]."</ref>
